plugins.title: Context Diet
plugins.description:
Almost nothing an agent charges you for is what it writes — it is the conversation so far, read again, on every turn. This ships three workers pinned to the model each job needs (find, build, check) so the reading happens where it is not re-read, and a `read`-scope panel that keeps the tally: not how many turns are large, but how much of all the re-reading those turns carry.

It is one plugin with two halves — the panel here, and skills and agents in Claude Code — because two different programs

plugins.title: Jev Inbox
plugins.description: Scores each new Inbox notification with TypeSafe's Jev model — does it need you, and how urgently — and shows a needs-you badge and an optional sort order. Off until you add your own TypeSafe key and tick that the notification title leaves this machine; links, names, emails and secrets are removed first, and comments, code and authors are never sent. It only badges and orders: nothing is hidden or marked read.

plugins.title: Local Review
plugins.description: Reviews your pull requests on this machine with the agent and model you choose, inside a sandbox that cannot write or reach GitHub, and puts the findings in the pull request view. Nothing is posted. This update (commit 23d71e32a1496720153fcd677a4b49d9ed74daaa) makes the label trigger instant through the pr-changed event, polls every 60 s with a forced refresh, shows a visible error when the GitHub login is unknown, and keeps Explain and Re-check as one short call capped at 0.30 USD.

plugins.title: Accounts
plugins.description: Keeps your Claude logins side by side and switches between them from the usage popover, so a second account is one click away instead of a logout and a login. It touches Claude Code's login: it saves each account's tokens in its own slot and replaces the live ones when you switch, so the two login files it asks for show in red. It refreshes an expired saved token the way Claude Code does and shows each account's usage. Needs a build with the accounts contribution.
